item.title: EPD investigating Monday afternoon stabbing on Bristol Street
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- The Elkhart Police Department reports there is an ongoing investigation into a stabbing which occurred in the 1000 block of W. Bristol Street, Monday, around 3:30 p.m.

item.title: Elkhart couple face felony drug charges following ISP investigation
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- The Indiana State Police are reporting an Elkhart couple has been arrested following an investigation into the dealing of fentanyl.

item.title: City unveils revised paid parking plan, invites St. Joseph residents to give feedback
item.description: ST. JOSPEH, Mich. -- After a rocky rollout of paid street parking last year, the city of St. Joseph is inviting residents to weigh in on a revised plan ahead of the upcoming tourist season.

item.title: Dwayne Clemons charged with multiple felonies following Amber Alert
item.description: NORTH JUDSON, Ind.-- On Feb. 9, detectives with the Starke County Sheriff’s Department submitted a report to the Starke County Prosecutor’s office regarding the incident surrounding the Amber Alert that was issued on Friday, Feb. 6.

item.title: Questions still surround shooting death of 10-year-old in Mishawaka
item.description: MISHAWAKA, Ind. -- On Monday, the Mishawaka Police Department identified the victim of Saturday's deadly shooting as 10-year-old Sophia Burks.

item.title: Latest details on potential data center development in Fulton County
item.description: FULTON COUNTY, Ind. — ABC57 visited a data center open house Monday, held by Decennial Group, the company looking to bring a 500-megawatt hyper scale data center to the small town of Akron.

item.title: Memorial grows for 17-year-old boy fatally shot by police in Elkhart
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. — A memorial continues to grow at High Dive Pavilion in Elkhart following a fatal officer involved shooting early Sunday morning.

item.title: Bicyclist injured after sideswiping school bus
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- On Monday, Feb. 9, at approximately 4:40 p.m. a 31-year-old bicyclist sideswiped a school bus.

item.title: Dog rescued after falling through ice in Buchanan
item.description: BUCHANAN, Mich. -- On Saturday, Feb. 7, at approximately 6:10 p.m. Buchanan firefighters were dispatched to the 4000 block of Bear Cave Road to assist Michigan State Police in locating a dog in the river.

item.title: City leaders discuss economic future
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The South Bend Common Council held a meeting Monday night to focus on Mayor Mueller presentation of the city of South Bend's finances.
